_comment: Generic stdio MCP client shape. Not every client uses this `mcpServers`
key -- see the client-specific examples in this directory (VS Code uses
`servers`, Codex uses `mcp_servers` TOML sections, Caros uses `extensions`
Replace <YOU> with the Windows account that ran the PLAXIS-MCP installer,
Run `plaxis-mcp.exe setup` once per machine before first use.
No password appears here: --role reads the generated profile, which names
a Windows Credential Manager target, and `serve` refuses to start if any
PLAXIS_* endpoint environment override is set.
